heroHeadline: Saudi Arabia and Houthis Exchange Strikes on Both Capitals' Airports in Major Escalation
heroSubtitle: Houthis targeted Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport while the Saudi-led coalition struck Sanaa International Airport, marking dangerous mutual targeting of civilian aviation infrastructure. Flights between Saudi Arabia and India remain disrupted, affecting thousands of Indian expatriates.
footerNote: Data sourced from Saudi Press Agency, Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP, Washington Post, Bloomberg, NBC News, CNN, NPR, ABC News (Australia), TASS, Türkiye Today, Anadolu Agency, News.Az, Yemen Monitor, Arab News, The Hindu, UN OCHA, UN News, World Health Organization, Security Council Report, CFR Global Conflict Tracker, Trading Economics, and the US Senate Armed Services Committee record. Contested claims flagged with opposing perspectives.
